description: Edit app.txt in place: bump VERSION from __NEXT__ to 1.2.0
prompt: The file app.txt contains VERSION=__NEXT__. Edit it in place so the line reads VERSION=1.2.0 (keep everything else unchanged).

checks.name: version bumped
checks.run: python3 -c "line = [l for l in open('app.txt') if l.startswith('VERSION=')][0]; assert line.strip() == 'VERSION=1.2.0', line"

checks.name: other lines intact
checks.run: python3 -c "lines = open('app.txt').read().splitlines(); assert 'APP=blazorly' in lines and 'MODE=release' in lines, lines"
